{{Quote|At last! Actions like these were the doorway to advancement, sought after by any ARC trooper worth manka spit.|Advanced Recon Commando A-98 'Nate', reflecting upon his elite assignment to escort two Jedi Masters on their critical mission to Ord Cestus in 22 BBY|<ref name="The Cestus Deception">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref>}}
'''Manka cats''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Fur-covered quadrupeds, manka cats were considered dangerous by most sentients who encountered them, and were often hunted for safety reasons as well as for food gathering. While hunted primarily for their meat, manka tusks and teeth were also prized for their medicinal use to cure illnesses. Carnivores with gnashing teeth and strong forelegs with sharp claws, the manka hunted in packs and alone, capable of bringing down [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] and other large animals.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:MankaCatCub-SS.png|thumb|left|200px|A Jedi hermit holding a manka cat cub.]]
Capable of domestication, manka cats were kept by the [[Flesh Raider]]s of Tython in their camps, gnawing on bones of past prey and aiding in the defense of their camps from local [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] exploring the region during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

Manka cats saw some exportation during the history of the Galactic Republic to other worlds, including [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and a [[U-Tendik|jungle planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> Therefore, when the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to Tython collapsed and Alderaan was destroyed in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], manka cats were still widespread in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and knowledge and familiarity with them was quite commonplace.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
